unsafe_justifications: The safe public entry point independently calls is_supported before entering the private AArch64-only function annotated with target_feature(enable = neon). Unsupported configurations use a complete local scalar implementation.
Four unaligned vld1q_u8 loads use offsets 0, 16, 32, and 48 within the borrowed 64-byte array. Each load has 16 readable initialized bytes and no access extends beyond that object.
All vector comparisons use unsigned byte intrinsics. Comparison results and their Boolean combinations contain only 0x00 or 0xff, satisfying the private reducer precondition.

The reducer loads eight initialized power-of-two weights and sums each vector half separately. Each sum is at most 255. Explicit half placement preserves byte-address order without native-endian integer reinterpretation, matching classify.rs.
Lane masks are converted to u64 before shifting by 0, 16, 32, or 48. Every unsafe operation appears inside an explicit unsafe block with its safety justification.
The AArch64 reducer test checks CPU support before its native load and helper call, using an initialized 16-byte array containing only valid comparison bytes.

test_vectors.name: exact_mixed_class_vector
test_vectors.coverage: Explicit expected masks for all ten classes, whitespace/control overlap, punctuation, digit endpoints, ignored quotes and backslashes, and high bytes.

test_vectors.name: every_byte_value_at_every_position
test_vectors.coverage: All 256 byte values at each of 64 positions, totaling 16384 single-position vectors, compared with independent membership expectations for both scalar and selected paths.

test_vectors.name: all_uniform_blocks_include_full_width_masks
test_vectors.coverage: All 256 uniform blocks, including zero masks and u64::MAX masks.

test_vectors.name: lane_boundaries_and_high_bit_keep_address_order
test_vectors.coverage: Positions 0, 15, 16, 31, 32, 47, 48, and 63 must form mask 0x8001800180018001; alternating digit/high-byte input must form 0x5555555555555555 and 0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.

test_vectors.name: unsigned_boundaries_and_non_json_whitespace
test_vectors.coverage: Rotated boundary alphabet includes controls, VT, FF, space, slash, digit endpoints, colon, DEL, 0x80, 0x85, 0xa0, and 0xff.

test_vectors.name: deterministic_permutations_and_mixed_blocks
test_vectors.coverage: 256 byte permutations and 512 mixed blocks from fixed xorshift seed 0x243f6a8885a308d3, compared with an independent oracle.

test_vectors.name: arrays_at_every_alignment_are_read_without_mutation
test_vectors.coverage: Complete 64-byte arrays at all 16 alignment residues, including an array ending at the backing object's end, with input preservation assertions.

test_vectors.name: raw_classes_survive_quoting_and_invalid_utf8
test_vectors.coverage: Raw punctuation inside a quoted string survives classification while final structural punctuation is excluded. Controls and invalid UTF-8 bytes remain classified, and opaque UTF-8 carry is preserved.

test_vectors.name: assembly_clips_raw_classes_at_every_valid_length
test_vectors.coverage: All lengths 0 through 64 across representatives of every class verify clipping, zero-length behavior, full-width behavior, and structural assembly.

test_vectors.name: integration_errors_preserve_raw_masks_and_carry
test_vectors.coverage: Structural classification is infallible by contract. Integration tests verify assembly errors for lengths 65, 255, 256, and usize::MAX and quote errors for noncanonical carry, including Scanner source, zero offset, and unchanged state.

test_vectors.name: native_reduction_covers_every_sixteen_bit_pattern
test_vectors.coverage: On supported AArch64, all 65536 comparison patterns exercise the native reducer and verify exact byte-to-bit placement.
